review_candidates.description: The Store Design Specialist / Junior Retail Architect will support the planning, design, development, and execution of retail stores and fit-out projects across the organization. The role will work closely with the Retail Architect Lead, internal teams, architects, consultants, contractors, and vendors to develop and deliver store designs in line with approved brand standards, design concepts, technical requirements, timelines, and quality expectations. The position will be responsible for preparing and updating architectural drawings, supporting 3D design development, coordinating technical documentation, following up on site execution, and ensuring that approved designs are properly implemented. 3. Core Competencies Agility Proactivity Problem Solving Teamwork Attention to Detail Accountability 4. Technical Competencies Retail Architecture / Store Design Space Planning Architectural Drafting Fit-Out Coordination Technical Documentation CAD & 3D Visualization Site Coordination Design Standards & Quality Control 5. Key Responsibilities A. Store Design & Space Planning Support the development of retail store layouts and design concepts in alignment with approved brand guidelines. Prepare architectural layouts, floor plans, elevations, sections, and detailed drawings. Assist in space planning to ensure effective use of retail areas and a good customer experience. Support the development and modification of store concepts based on project requirements. Assist in material, finishes, fixtures, and design selections. Ensure consistency of design elements and brand identity across different store locations. B. Technical Drawings & Documentation Prepare and update AutoCAD drawings and other architectural documentation. Develop and maintain technical drawings, design presentations, and construction documentation. Support the preparation and development of 3D models and visualizations using SketchUp, Revit, 3ds Max, or similar tools. Coordinate drawing revisions and incorporate feedback from the Retail Architect Lead, consultants, and stakeholders. Ensure drawings and documents are accurate, organized, and updated throughout the project lifecycle. C. Fit-Out & Site Coordination Support the Retail Architect Lead in monitoring store fit-out and construction activities. Conduct site visits to follow up on design implementation and identify discrepancies between approved drawings and site execution. Coordinate with contractors, consultants, suppliers, and other project stakeholders regarding design and technical requirements. Raise technical issues and support the team in identifying appropriate solutions. Follow up on project progress and report any delays, design issues, or execution concerns. D. Design Quality & Compliance Ensure that store designs and drawings follow approved company and brand standards. Support compliance with applicable building regulations, safety requirements, and authority requirements. Review site execution against approved drawings, specifications, and design standards. Identify design or quality issues and escalate them to the Retail Architect Lead. Support corrective actions when design or execution issues are identified. E. Project Support Assist with project schedules, design deliverables, and project documentation. Support multiple store design and fit-out projects simultaneously. Coordinate with internal departments to understand business and operational requirements. Assist in preparing design presentations and project updates for internal stakeholders. Maintain organized project records, drawings, revisions, and documentation. F. Continuous Improvement Stay updated on retail design trends, materials, store concepts, and industry practices. Suggest practical design improvements that can enhance customer experience, functionality, quality, or cost efficiency. Support the development and implementation of new store concepts and design initiatives. 6. Job Requirements Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Architectural Engineering, Interior Design, or a related field. 2–5 years of experience in retail architecture, store design, interior design, commercial fit-out, or a related field. Experience in retail or commercial projects is preferred. Experience with site coordination and fit-out projects is an advantage. Systems & Languages

Join the exciting and dynamic world of policing and contribute towards making Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Hertfordshire a safer place. Based at Hertfordshire Constabulary HQ or Cambridgeshire Constabulary, you will play a key role within the ICT Operations Team, supporting the tri-force ICT estate and ensuring that vital business systems remain highly available to officers and staff. About The Role As a Senior Service Desk Analyst, you will provide first-line ICT support while also taking on additional responsibility for supporting and guiding a team of five analysts. You will act as an escalation point for more complex or non-standard issues, helping to drive service quality and improve first-time fix rates. You will use your technical knowledge and customer service skills to diagnose hardware, software and communication issues reported via phone or self-service. Where resolution is not possible at first contact, you will ensure incidents are accurately logged, fully documented, and escalated within agreed SLAs, maintaining clear communication with users throughout. You will also contribute to continuous improvement by maintaining knowledge base articles and coaching the development of colleagues across the Service Desk. Why Join BCH ICT? Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Hertfordshire Police form one of the largest and most established collaborations in the UK. This role offers a fantastic opportunity to develop your career within a supportive and forward-thinking ICT environment, with exposure to a diverse technology estate and opportunities to build leadership experience. Employee Benefits 25 days annual leave, rising to 29 after 5 years’ service (plus public holidays) Competitive Local Government Pension Scheme Access to on-site gym facilities at HQ locations Hybrid working arrangements Blue Light Card discounts Sports and social club membership Employee Assistance Programme Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Everyone at Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Hertfordshire takes personal responsibility to help create an inclusive workplace, where police officers and staff respect one another, feel valued for their differences and can be themselves. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments, wherever needed so everyone feels welcome and can flourish. We are working hard to continue to enhance and increase our diversity across the three forces, where communities are under-represented, including those from Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic communities, people of all ages, abilities, faiths, religions and gender, LGBT communities and those from other disadvantaged or marginalised backgrounds, who share our values and wish to make a difference to the communities we serve. All applications will be treated on merit, based on the evidence provided in your application and your suitability for the role for which you have applied. We are a Disability Confident employer offering a guaranteed interview scheme for all candidates with a disability covered by the Equality Act 2010 who meet the minimum entry requirements. Should you require any reasonable adjustments for your application process, please contact the HR Recruitment Centre on 01438 757 777. Flexible Working BCH supports agile and flexible working wherever possible. All requests will be considered in line with operational requirements. Police Barred and Advisory lists Individuals placed on the Police Barred and Advisory lists will not be considered for employment by the police for a minimum of 5 years from the date of listing in the case of gross misconduct, or 3 years from the date of listing in the case of poor performance. Vetting and Safeguarding BCH are committed to safeguarding and operate safer recruitment processes, to ensure a police service that employees are proud to work for because they feel safe, valued and part of a happy and supportive work environment. All employees and volunteers therefore will be subject to background checks including vetting and references. Please be aware the Police Corporate Vetting Unit will undertake security vetting on successful candidates, their family and others that live at their home address, which will include financial checks. How To Apply If you are successful, you will be joining one of the most accomplished policing collaborations in the UK where our vision for the future of BCH Policing is exhibited daily across the full breadth of capabilities and functions we deliver. Please Submit Your CV Along With Evidence of your relevant skills and experience A 500-word statement demonstrating how you meet the minimum entry requirements For further information, please contact Jamie Read (BCH Operations, ICT Service Desk Team Leader) via Jamie.Read@cambs.police.uk Additional Advert Information Internal Applicants To apply for this role, internal applicants must have successfully completed their probationary period. If you qualify as an internal candidate within the advertising force, you may upload either your CV or the internal role summary form attached to this advert. Vetting Process Please note that, as part of the vetting process, the BCH Vetting Unit may need to contact your current line manager for a Supervisor Appraisal. This requirement aligns with the 2025 National Guidelines for Vetting (APP 6.5.18). Examples Of When This May Apply Include Transferring to another force Renewing vetting clearance Moving into a role requiring MV clearance (even if you currently hold MV clearance) Moving into or working in a role involving close contact with vulnerable individuals If any of the above apply to you, please expect your line manager to be contacted when you submit your vetting application. Redeployment and Redundancy This vacancy is open to employees at risk of redundancy and will remain available to redeployees until a final offer has been agreed and accepted. Redeployees at risk of redundancy will take priority over all other applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. If successful, redeployees will remain on their home force’s terms and conditions. Role Profile We recommend downloading and saving a copy of the role profile, as it will no longer be accessible once the advert closes. Commitment to Inclusion As a Disability Confident Leader, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and able to be themselves. review_candidates.job_function: Customer Service, Information Technology, and Finance
review_candidates.description: Connext is a dedicated team of business process outsourcing experts and innovators, with experience in supporting world-class companies in Title and Escrow, Healthcare, Produce Distribution, Retail and Fashion, Design Consulting, and Finance. We are currently looking for a Client Support Specialist who will be working with Connext's Client in the United States of America What's in it for you? Competitive compensation Perfect Attendance Bonus Life insurance HMO Insurance Great company culture 25% Night Differential Annual Increase What is the job? The Client Support Specialist 2 provides technical and operational support to clients using financial technology platforms. The role manages daily client inquiries, troubleshoots platform and system issues, monitors system performance, investigates reported problems, and coordinates with internal teams to resolve issues while maintaining a high level of client service. Responsibilities: Serve as a primary point of contact for international clients and respond to daily platform-related inquiries. Provide guidance to clients on platform features, functionality, and processes. Troubleshoot client issues and identify appropriate solutions or escalation paths. Prioritize and manage client requests based on urgency and business impact. Maintain accurate documentation of client interactions, issues, actions taken, and resolutions in the CRM/ticketing system. Ensure client concerns are addressed promptly and professionally. Monitor platform performance and system activity using available monitoring tools. Investigate system issues and collaborate with internal technical teams to identify root causes and resolutions. Track and document bugs, system issues, and other technical concerns through appropriate ticketing or collaboration tools. Support testing and validation of new platform functionality, fixes, and enhancements. Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve platform processes and client support. Build strong relationships with clients through responsive and effective communication. Explain technical concepts and solutions clearly to non-technical clients. Work closely with internal teams to ensure client issues are resolved efficiently. Identify opportunities to improve processes, workflows, and overall client experience. Follow company policies, procedures, and established support practices. Qualifications: Minimum of three (3) years of experience in client-facing technical support or a similar role. Experience using any CRM or ticketing systems. Experience providing technical support and troubleshooting for clients. Experience handling phone interactions with clients while maintaining professionalism and positive client relationships. Proficiency in providing detailed technical support and troubleshooting various technical challenges. Demonstrates strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a systematic approach to investigating issues. Demonstrates strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing tasks, documentation, and reporting. Proven ability to analyze data, generate reports, and identify errors or inconsistencies. Proven ability to communicate technical information clearly to non-technical clients. Proven ability to prioritize multiple client issues and manage competing requests effectively. Proven ability to work collaboratively with internal technical teams and other stakeholders. Proven ability to independently investigate issues and determine appropriate solutions or escalation paths. Clear and coherent both written and verbal communication skills in English.

review_candidates.title: Start Your Career in Call Center | Zamalek | English A2+ | Students & Graduates Welcome
review_candidates.description: Company Description Gourmet Egypt is a leading food retail and production company that has been serving passionate food lovers since 2006. The company combines premium imported and local ingredients with “Handcrafted by Gourmet” products developed by in-house culinary experts and visiting celebrity chefs. With a strong focus on customer care, Gourmet Egypt treats every customer like family and builds a community around the love of good food. The organization also invests in innovation through a state-of-the-art e-commerce platform, including a webstore, mobile app, and shopable recipes. Team members at Gourmet Egypt are valued for their skill, passion for food, and strong team spirit. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site call center role based in Zamalek, Cairo, designed for students and recent graduates starting their careers. The Call Center team member will handle incoming customer calls, respond to inquiries about products and services, and provide clear, courteous support in English (A2+ level). Day-to-day tasks include managing orders, resolving basic issues, updating customer information, and ensuring a smooth customer experience across phone and digital channels. The role involves following defined processes, documenting interactions accurately, and collaborating with colleagues to maintain high service standards. Training and guidance will be provided to help team members grow their skills and progress in their careers at Gourmet Egypt. Qualifications Strong Customer Service skills, including patience, empathy, and a commitment to high-quality support. Effective Communication abilities in English at A2+ level, with clear speaking and active listening skills. Analytical Skills to understand customer needs, identify issues, and follow straightforward problem-solving steps. Interest in Career Development and willingness to learn, take feedback, and grow within a call center environment. Basic understanding or interest in Career Counseling concepts, such as guiding customers toward suitable products or services. Ability to work on-site in Zamalek, Cairo, on a full-time schedule, with strong punctuality and reliability. Comfort using computers and call center systems; familiarity with e-commerce or retail is an advantage. Students and graduates from any field are welcome; prior call center or customer-facing experience is a plus but not required.
